report_title: OpsSentinel AI Enterprise — Final Results & Limitations Report
author: Harsh Ramesh Nerkar

scope_cut_summary.rationale: Pruned during Sprint 2 replan to prevent overtime and protect contingency buffer. Universal REST/CLI ingress provides 100% of required delivery surface.

honest_limitations: Zero-knowledge RAG ceiling: Cannot extrapolate remediation for un-indexed custom infrastructure
Metadata dependency: Relies on accurate service and environment labels in inbound alerts
Cold-start latency: First-query cache misses incur ~120ms cold-start overhead
Audit log locality: Audit hash-chain is currently stored on single-instance volume (multi-region sync in v1.3)
